verdict.summary:
SPEC-0394: declared personas now carry their own run settings and reviewer routing metadata, get correct run requests and a generated Output section, and show these fields in `nw personas`. The queue still cannot run them.
A user or project definition can now set `model`/`effort`/`max_budget_usd`, and a reviewer can also set `required`/`when`. Both validators check these keys through one helper, `check_declared_keys`. `Persona.declared` holds the values plus the template's sha256, and `is_reviewer` is new. `build_request` finds the persona in `project_cfg["_root"]` and layers settings as nightwright defaults < the profile's role-default entry < the definition < the profile's `personas.<name>` entry. Read-only roles are always forced to `read_only: true` / `dontAsk`. The capability page is updated.
tests_run: uv run pytest -q -n 4 tests/test_agentic_persona_run_settings.py tests/test_agentic_personas_declared_cli.py tests/test_agentic_persona_defs.py tests/test_agentic_personas.py (189 passed)
uv run pytest -q -n 4 tests/test_agentic_persona_registry.py tests/test_agentic_personas_cli.py tests/test_remote_personas.py tests/test_docs_product_ia.py tests/test_agentic_profiles.py (pass)

python3 tools/affected_tests.py --run uv run pytest -q -n 8 (3463 passed, 9 failed; all 9 also fail on an unmodified git-archive copy of HEAD, so they were already failing before this change: slot/admission tests)
manual: real nw personas show/validate CLI against a scratch project with the example definition (recorded in the spec's Test record)

ac_status.ac: AC1 settings keys accepted/refused; refused in builtin definitions
AC2 required/when reviewer-only with strict shapes and defaults
AC3 validate and list/show report the same problems via one helper; all problems in one run
AC5 build_request declared reviewer: read-only/dontAsk, schema, layered settings; declared implementer writable
AC6 review context, resolved from _root, worktree copy ignored
AC7 generated Output section; builtin prompts byte-identical
AC8 show/list --json show settings/required/when/template_sha256 for declared, not builtins
AC9 inert: tables unchanged, resolve_profile refuses a declared reviewer, queue/profiles/divergence untouched
AC10 capability page documents declared personas

followup_ideas: Nine queue tests already fail on main at 6e66fcda, before this change (slot/admission accounting, possibly after SPEC-0395): test_agentic_exit_paths admission_blocked x3, test_agentic_watchdog_gaps::test_waiting_not_admitted_quiet_when_full_or_park_requested, test_agentic_loop_state::test_run_stamps_slot_freed_at_on_drop, test_agentic_queue_visibility::test_width_snapshots x3, test_tui_queue_model::test_load_queue_sections_order_and_meta.

`nw idea clock-in/out` is refused inside campaign runs (NW_PERSONA_RUN=1), but AGENTS.md tells implementers to clock in. Either reconcile the contract or let clock entries be written from a campaign run.
Merge the two declared-persona validators (persona_registry.validate_persona_doc and persona_defs._read_file) into one, as the spec's Non-goals note.
